description:
Send an existing unsent draft by its document_id. Do not provide PDF
    bytes or a template ID: use send_envelope for new PDFs or
    send_from_template for a saved template. The draft must have signing
    fields, with recipient roles matching the field parties. Omit recipients
    to use the draft's saved list, or pass the full replacement list of
    {name, email, role} for this send. If no recipients are saved, provide
    at least one. To edit saved recipients without sending, use the dashboard
    editor; update_draft only changes fields.

    Success changes the draft to Sent and normally costs 1 credit. Set
    send_invite=false to suppress invitations, or send_completion_email=false
    to suppress signer completion emails. sequential defaults true (one at a
    time); set false for everyone at once. prefill =
    {"party:name": "text"} sets or overrides text field defaults for this
    send only; unknown or non-text keys are a 422 invalid_prefill_key. An
    encrypted PDF stored on the draft is a 422 with code pdf_encrypted and
    is not charged. Set metadata.revision_of to a changes-requested source
    document_id for its one-time free resend while the promotion is enabled.
    Requires envelopes:send access.
name: send_draft
title: Send Draft
